title: A provider test's @State methods set up and tear down each state, and a failed interaction fails its own test with its mismatches.
why: provider-test-migration.md, pact-jvm: `@State` methods, taking the state's parameters as a `Map` and returning provider-state values, with `action = TEARDOWN` the teardown, are kept; a failed interaction's test fails with the result's mismatches.
